survey: Outdoor stone chess table with two stools on grass. The table is a thick square stone slab with a raised rim and an inlaid checkerboard on top, facing up toward the camera at a three-quarter view. A collar under the slab connects it to a tapered square pedestal, which stands on a wider stepped square plinth sitting flat on the grass. Two round stools stand on either side, one in front-left and one behind-right. Each is a single turned stone piece: a round seat, a waisted column with a ring moulding, and a round footed base resting on the grass. All three pieces are solid monolithic stone. Nothing hangs loose, and nothing floats or needs joints. The shadows put each base on the ground.
